summary: Full backend + frontend testing of D.O.X Capital. 27/27 pytest backend tests passing (after fixing one self-introduced case-sensitivity assertion). End-to-end UI flows all green: landing page sections render, discovery-call booking generates Jitsi link, registration -> admin approval -> approved user login -> upload + sign documents tabs all work, pending user sees 'under review' banner with no upload/sign tabs, admin can approve/reject and view bookings/uploads.

minor.issue: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; should migrate to lifespan context manager (non-blocking warning only)
AuthProvider calls /auth/me on every page load including anonymous landing page -> generates 401 console errors. Harmless but noisy; could be silenced or skipped on public routes.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Suppress /auth/me 401 console noise on public landing/book pages by not calling it until needed, or silence in axios interceptor.
(Optional) Migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown handlers to lifespan API to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend single-file (~700 lines) is acceptable for MVP; consider splitting into routers/services if it grows further.

Cookies set with secure=True and samesite=lax — correct for HTTPS preview env. Auth supports both cookies and Bearer tokens for download endpoint via ?auth= query, cookie, or header — flexible and good.
Object storage init lazy-loaded and cached; failures gracefully degrade to 503.
Resend email properly MOCKED with '[EMAIL MOCK]' log lines as documented.
MongoDB _id explicitly excluded from all responses — verified in tests.
Email is normalized to lowercase on register/login/booking — consistent and correct.
test_credentials: Admin: deptofx@proton.me / DoxAdmin!2026 (auto-seeded). Pending/approved test users created dynamically via /api/auth/register during tests; deterministic seed not auto-created (intentional per problem statement).
seed_data_creation: Tests dynamically create TEST_-prefixed users, a booking, and an upload. No cleanup performed (test users remain in DB as pending/approved/rejected). Recommend a periodic cleanup script if running repeatedly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env automatically. All 27 tests should pass on clean DB. RESEND_API_KEY remains blank by design — emails are logged with [EMAIL MOCK] prefix. Object storage uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY which is configured and working (verified by successful upload + download in tests). The auth flow uses httpOnly cookies AND optional Bearer token; downloads also accept ?auth= query param.
rca of the issue: Only failure was self-induced: my assertion expected uppercase email 'TEST_booker@example.com' but backend correctly lowercases stored emails. Fixed test assertion (.lower()). No real bug in product code.
